first_divergence.exact_span: In order for that to happen, its acceleration would also have to blow up, which means its jerk has to blow up, and so on and so on.
first_divergence.mechanism: The continuation criterion establishes failure of an H^m bound; it does not force material acceleration, then jerk, then every higher response to diverge. The prose next switches from particle-path quantities to fixed-point Eulerian time derivatives, but no argument licenses either implication, so the temporal tower begins with an asserted necessity.
first_divergence.repair_constraint: Preserve the physical acceleration/jerk intuition and the material-versus-Eulerian distinction, but present this ladder only as the singular-cascade expectation unless a precise implication is proved; let the pressure-complete differentiated equation supply the reason to study every Eulerian temporal row.
